_about: views: the photos of the street (calibration as described below), used by the map and by scripts/centre_view.py. centre_views: AI images of the street from the centre of the road (scripts/centre_view.py), the views of street.html; lat/lon is the road centre, horizon_y and vanishing_x where the street lines meet, focal_px assumes a 70 degree horizontal field of view. Photo calibration: horizon_y and vanishing_x are where the street's parallel lines (kerbs, building base, lane markings) meet; street_bearing_deg is the street direction from OSM (way 81083900), towards the vanishing point. ground: polygon where objects can be placed. foreground: photo parts in front of anything placed. kerbs: one image point on the left and on the right kerb of each centre view; trees may only stand beyond them, cars between them.

edit._about: Lane layout: the lane next to the centre line is for all traffic, the strip along the kerb by the stop (beyond the solid line) is the bus lane. The model removes the BUS lettering from the general lane ('instruction'; only the area around the bright pixels in 'remove.box', not near 'keep_line', the bus lane's edge, is kept); the script paints BUS into the bus lane ('quad', image pixels).
edit.instruction: Remove the large white BUS letters painted on the road surface, leaving plain wet asphalt there. Keep everything else exactly the same: all lane lines, the bus shelter, the trees, buildings, light and camera.

bus._about: SWH line 32 along Weipertstraße (OpenStreetMap route relations 2176648, 2176650, 2186099): northbound via Industrieplatz and Salzstraße to Frankenbach Maihalde, southbound via Europaplatz and Mannheimer Straße to Sontheim Güldensteinstraße.

stop.name: Etzelstraße
stop._about: Bus stop at the shelter in each view (OpenStreetMap: stop 'Etzelstraße', about 30 m south of the camera point, platforms on both sides). The sign as photographed at the southbound platform: white panel with a round top, H symbol, name on blue (name_lines), lines with destinations. Per view: pole, the sign's ground point in image pixels; roof_y, the image height of the shelter roof there, which the panel stands on and which sets its size; and the lines of that platform (OSM route relations: southbound 5 Jäkleinstraße in Böckingen, 31 Horkheim, 32 Sontheim, as on the sign; northbound 5 Industrieplatz, 31 Kirchhausen, 32 Frankenbach).

demo._about: The Demo scene button (street.js demoScene): [kind, tree preset, metres east of the centre line, metres north along the street axis] from the common camera point; it replaces what is placed. South of the camera as in the brochure. Every position keeps the placement rules (checked by placing each by hand).
